cracks.model_scope: experimental; provisional labels; synthetic or unverified scenes; no real production validation
cracks.score_type: uncalibrated forest score, not a probability
cracks.trace_method: blackhat connected-line geometry; not trained crack segmentation
cracks.note: Visible-surface screening; no indication is not proof of no crack. Each pellet counted once.

region.coordinates: upright analyzed photo pixels; image not cropped or resized by ROI
region.inclusion_rule: entire detected ellipse inside ROI; unfitted seed boundary retained
